extDescription.message: Links the TwitchUnblock site to your Twitch session: points, chests, drops, rewards, predictions, polls. Session stays here.

subtitle.message: Your Twitch session for the TwitchUnblock site

sessionNone.message: Log in to twitch.tv in this browser.

sessionInvalid.message: Twitch refused the session: log in to twitch.tv again.

sessionError.message: Could not check the Twitch session (network?).

integrityNone.message: No integrity token yet: it is obtained at the first action that needs one.

permsMissing.message: The browser has not granted all the access the extension needs (twitch.tv and the TwitchUnblock site).

permsHint.message: If nothing happens: open the add-ons manager, choose TwitchUnblock Connect, then Permissions, and allow every site.

setSiteHelp.message: Lets the site read your points, drops, rewards, predictions and polls, play lives in 1440p and above through your account, and use your session for the actions below.

setClaimHelp.message: Claims bonus chests and finished drops while you watch a live stream on the site.

setSpend.message: Bets, votes and rewards from the site

setSpendHelp.message: Always after a real click on the site and its confirmation.

diagRunning.message: Checking the session and getting a new integrity token… (a few seconds)

diagFailed.message: The extension's background did not answer.

diagSessionNone.message: No Twitch session: the auth-token cookie is missing. Log in to twitch.tv.

diagSessionInvalid.message: Session refused by Twitch (expired or invalid).

securityText.message: Your Twitch session and tokens never leave the extension. The site can only ask for a closed list of actions; bets, votes and rewards need a real click. Nothing is sent anywhere but Twitch. For 1440p, the site only gets the live's playlists, rewritten: the addresses of the video pieces, never your playback token.
